approvals.condition: Required when the proposed industrial activity/process falls under MPCB consent requirements.
required_documents: Details of proposed water pollution control devices
Details of proposed air pollution control devices
approvals.notes: MPCB states that Consent to Establish must be obtained before actual establishment of an industry/activity that requires consent. Consent to Operate is a separate requirement.

approvals.condition: Required before actual commencement of production, including trial production, for industrial activities that require MPCB consent.
required_documents: Details of installed water pollution control devices
Details of installed air pollution control devices
approvals.notes: Consent to Operate is required before actual commencement of production, including trial production.

approvals.condition: Applicable when the industrial activity involves handling, generation, collection, storage, transportation, treatment, processing, recycling, recovery, utilization or disposal of hazardous and other waste covered by the applicable rules.
required_documents: Details of hazardous waste generated or handled
Details of storage and handling arrangements
Details of treatment, recycling, recovery or disposal arrangements
approvals.notes: MPCB provides authorization procedures under the Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management & Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016. Applicability depends on the activity and hazardous-waste handling involved.

approvals.department: Concerned Fire Authority / Special Planning Authority (e.g., MIDC)
approvals.condition: Applicable where the proposed industrial building, premises or activity falls under the applicable fire-safety requirements. The competent fire authority may depend on the local authority or special planning authority for the site.
required_documents: Process flow chart for industrial activity
Raw material and finished goods details
approvals.notes: Maharashtra Fire & Emergency Services provides the e-approval process for fire safety approvals. The competent authority can depend on the local authority or special planning authority for the project site.

approvals.department: Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health (DISH), Maharashtra
approvals.condition: Applicable to establishments falling within the scope of the applicable factory and occupational safety requirements.
required_documents: Details of machinery and manufacturing process
approvals.source_name: Directorate of Industrial Safety and Health (DISH), Maharashtra
approvals.notes: Applicability depends on whether the establishment falls within the scope of the applicable factory legislation and safety requirements.
